brainstorm: Achieved: core package migrations, programmatic APIs, concurrency stability, thread-safe logger/api locks, multi-provider mappings, and sqlite exports. Next steps: 1. Explicitly decouple Local Mode (local load parameters via MLX/LM Studio CLI) from Remote Mode (API-key + URL gateway). 2. Generalize jmllm.run() inputs to accept direct absolute PDF file paths from anywhere on the filesystem. 3. Simplify installation and environment configurations to make jmllm a professional, lightweight standard package for ontology-constrained literature evaluations.
